properties.text: Exchange rate must equal (cash + totalBorrows - reserves) / cTokenSupply when supply > 0.
properties.assertion: forall market m: m.totalSupply > 0 => exchangeRate(m) == (getCash(m) + m.totalBorrows - m.totalReserves) / m.totalSupply

properties.text: Exchange rate must be monotonically non-decreasing over time (absent bad debt).
properties.assertion: forall market m, t1 < t2: exchangeRate(m, t2) >= exchangeRate(m, t1) when no bad_debt(m)

properties.text: First depositor cannot manipulate exchange rate to steal subsequent depositors' funds.
properties.assertion: forall market m: m.totalSupply == 0 => mint(m, amt) gives mintTokens >= min_threshold AND no inflation attack

properties.text: Underlying token transfer must succeed before minting cTokens (CEI pattern).
properties.assertion: forall mint(user, amt): doTransferIn(user, amt).success == true BEFORE totalSupply += mintTokens

properties.text: totalSupply must increase by exactly mintAmount/exchangeRate on mint.
properties.assertion: forall mint(user, amt): totalSupply_post == totalSupply_pre + floor(amt / exchangeRate)

properties.text: Redeem must not cause borrower shortfall (collateral check before withdrawal).
properties.assertion: forall redeem(user, tokens): getAccountLiquidity(user).shortfall == 0 AFTER redeem

properties.text: Market must have sufficient cash for withdrawal (getCash >= redeemAmount).
properties.assertion: forall redeem(user, amt): getCash(market) >= redeemAmount => transfer succeeds

properties.text: Borrow must not exceed borrowing capacity (collateral value > total borrow value).
properties.assertion: forall borrow(user, amt): sum(collateral_i * exchangeRate_i * price_i * CF_i) > sum(borrow_j * price_j) + amt * price

properties.text: totalBorrows must increase by exactly the borrowed amount after borrow.
properties.assertion: forall borrow(user, amt): totalBorrows_post == totalBorrows_pre + amt

properties.text: Borrower checkpoint index must equal market borrow index at time of borrow.
properties.assertion: forall borrow(user, amt): accountBorrows[user].interestIndex == borrowIndex after borrow

properties.text: borrowBalanceCurrent must include all accrued interest: principal * currentIndex / storedIndex.
properties.assertion: forall account a: borrowBalance(a) == a.principal * borrowIndex / a.interestIndex

properties.text: repayAmount must not exceed current borrow balance (no overpayment).
properties.assertion: forall repay(user, amt): actualRepayAmount <= borrowBalanceCurrent(user)

properties.text: totalBorrows must decrease by exactly repayAmount after repay.
properties.assertion: forall repay(user, amt): totalBorrows_post == totalBorrows_pre - actualRepayAmount

properties.text: Liquidation requires borrower shortfall > 0 (borrower must be underwater).
properties.assertion: forall liquidate(liq, borrower, amt): getAccountLiquidity(borrower).shortfall > 0

properties.text: Liquidation closeAmount must not exceed borrowBalance * closeFactor.
properties.assertion: forall liquidate(liq, borrower, amt): actualClose <= borrowBalance(borrower) * closeFactor

properties.text: Self-liquidation must be prohibited (liquidator != borrower).
properties.assertion: forall liquidate(liq, borrower, amt): liq != borrower

properties.text: Seize must not change totalSupply of collateral cToken (transfer, not mint/burn).
properties.assertion: forall seize(liq, borrower, tokens): collateral.totalSupply_post == collateral.totalSupply_pre

properties.text: seizeTokens calculation must correctly include liquidation incentive and oracle prices.
properties.assertion: seizeTokens == actualRepay * liqIncentive * priceBorrow / (priceCollateral * exchangeRateCollateral)

properties.text: borrowIndex must be monotonically increasing (never decrease).
properties.assertion: forall market m, t1 < t2: borrowIndex(m, t2) >= borrowIndex(m, t1)

properties.text: accrueInterest must be idempotent within the same block.
properties.assertion: forall market m: accrueInterest(m) called twice in same block => second call is no-op

properties.text: Reserves must increase proportionally: reservesNew = reserves + interestAccumulated * reserveFactor.
properties.assertion: forall accrueInterest: totalReserves_post == totalReserves_pre + interestAccumulated * reserveFactor

properties.text: utilizationRate must be in range [0, 1]: totalBorrows / (cash + totalBorrows).
properties.assertion: forall market m: 0 <= utilizationRate(m) <= 1

properties.text: supplyRate must be <= borrowRate (suppliers earn less due to reserve factor).
properties.assertion: forall market m: supplyRate(m) <= borrowRate(m)

properties.text: collateralFactor must be in range [0, 1] for each market.
properties.assertion: forall market m: 0 <= collateralFactor(m) <= 1

properties.text: Oracle price must be non-zero for all markets used as collateral.
properties.assertion: forall market m where m.isCollateral: oracle.getPrice(m) > 0

properties.text: Oracle price must be fresh (within acceptable staleness threshold).
properties.assertion: forall price_feed pf: current_time - pf.publish_time <= staleness_threshold

properties.text: cToken transfer must conserve total supply (no tokens created or destroyed).
properties.assertion: forall transfer(src, dst, amt): totalSupply_post == totalSupply_pre

properties.text: cToken transfer from must not cause sender shortfall if market is entered.
properties.assertion: forall transfer(src, dst, amt): src.hasEnteredMarket => getAccountLiquidity(src).shortfall == 0 after

properties.text: Only admin/governance can list new markets via supportMarket.
properties.assertion: forall supportMarket(market): caller == admin || caller == governance

properties.text: New market initial collateralFactor must be 0 until explicitly set by admin.
properties.assertion: forall supportMarket(m): collateralFactor(m) == 0 after listing

properties.text: Market cannot be listed without a valid oracle price feed (price > 0).
properties.assertion: forall supportMarket(m): oracle.getPrice(m) > 0 at listing time

properties.text: Flash loan must repay full amount + fee within same transaction or revert.
properties.assertion: forall flash_loan(user, amt): balance_post >= balance_pre + fee OR tx reverts

properties.text: Flash loan must not allow collateral manipulation to bypass borrow capacity checks.
properties.assertion: forall flash_loan(user): borrow_capacity(user) checked AFTER flash_loan callback completes

properties.text: Oracle price must use confidence interval; reject if confidence > threshold relative to price.
properties.assertion: forall price_update(pf): pf.confidence / pf.price <= max_confidence_ratio

properties.text: Rounding in mint must be against the user (round down mintTokens).
properties.assertion: forall mint(user, amt): mintTokens == floor(amt / exchangeRate) (round down)

properties.text: Rounding in redeem must be against the user (round up redeemTokens for redeemUnderlying).
properties.assertion: forall redeemUnderlying(user, amt): redeemTokens == ceil(amt / exchangeRate) (round up)

properties.text: Dust positions must remain liquidatable (no minimum close amount preventing liquidation).
properties.assertion: forall borrower b: b.shortfall > 0 => exists closeAmount: liquidate(b, closeAmount) succeeds

properties.text: closeFactor must be in range (0, 1] to prevent zero or over-100% liquidation.
properties.assertion: forall market: 0 < closeFactor <= 1

properties.text: Interest accrual must not overflow: borrowIndex * (1 + rate * blockDelta) within safe bounds.
properties.assertion: forall accrueInterest: borrowIndex * (1 + borrowRate * blockDelta) <= MAX_U256 AND no overflow

properties.text: reserveFactor must be in range [0, 1] (cannot extract more than 100% of interest as reserves).
properties.assertion: forall market m: 0 <= reserveFactor(m) <= 1

properties.text: After repayBorrowBehalf, funds must be deducted from payer (msg.sender), not borrower.
properties.assertion: forall repayBehalf(payer, borrower, amt): payer.balance decreases AND borrower.borrowBalance decreases

properties.text: accrueInterest must be called before all state-changing operations (freshness guard).
properties.assertion: forall op in {mint,redeem,borrow,repay,liquidate}: block.number == accrualBlockNumber before op

properties.text: When totalSupply == 0, exchangeRate must return initialExchangeRate, not divide by zero.
properties.assertion: forall market m: m.totalSupply == 0 => exchangeRate(m) == initialExchangeRate

properties.text: Reserves must never exceed total assets: cash + totalBorrows >= totalReserves.
properties.assertion: forall market m: getCash(m) + m.totalBorrows >= m.totalReserves

properties.text: Utilization > 100% must be prevented: totalBorrows cannot exceed cash + totalBorrows.
properties.assertion: forall market m: m.totalBorrows <= getCash(m) + m.totalBorrows (tautological; enforce getCash >= 0)

properties.text: Borrow rate must be bounded by max borrow rate to prevent interest rate manipulation DoS.
properties.assertion: forall market m: borrowRate(m) <= maxBorrowRate

properties.text: Flash loan cannot be used to manipulate oracle price within same transaction.
properties.assertion: forall flash_loan(user): oracle.getPrice uses TWAP or external feed, not spot AMM price

properties.text: Cascading liquidation must not drain protocol reserves below safe threshold.
properties.assertion: forall liquidation_sequence: totalReserves >= min_reserve_threshold after all liquidations

properties.text: accountBorrowNew must not underflow on repay (accountBorrowNew >= 0).
properties.assertion: forall repay(user, amt): accountBorrows[user] - actualRepayAmount >= 0

properties.text: Donation attack: direct underlying transfer to market must not inflate exchange rate for attacker.
properties.assertion: forall market m: exchangeRate computed from getCash (balance check) not manipulable by donation

properties.text: E-mode must not allow cross-asset borrowing capacity to exceed safe ratio.
properties.assertion: forall emode_group g, user u: borrow_value(u, g) <= collateral_value(u, g) * emode_cf(g)

properties.text: Rate limiter must prevent single-block deposit/withdraw exceeding protocol-configured threshold.
properties.assertion: forall market m, window w: abs(net_flow(m, w)) <= rate_limit(m)

properties.text: Reward distribution index must be updated before any position change to prevent stale index exploit.
properties.assertion: forall position_change(user): reward_index updated BEFORE accountTokens[user] changes

properties.text: Zero-share deposit must be rejected to prevent share dilution attack.
properties.assertion: forall mint(user, amt): mintTokens > 0 OR tx reverts

properties.text: Decimal mismatch between underlying and cToken must be handled consistently in all calculations.
properties.assertion: forall market m: exchangeRate scaling accounts for (18 - 8 + underlyingDecimals) consistently

properties.text: ADL (Auto-Deleveraging) must only activate when bad debt exists and must distribute losses fairly.
properties.assertion: forall adl_event: bad_debt > 0 AND loss_distribution proportional to position_size

properties.text: Pyth oracle adaptor must validate price confidence and reject stale or low-confidence prices.
properties.assertion: forall pyth_price p: p.expo normalized AND p.conf/p.price <= threshold AND p.publish_time fresh

properties.text: Obligation health check must use consistent prices across all collateral and borrow markets in one tx.
properties.assertion: forall health_check(user): all prices fetched atomically within same oracle snapshot
